title: Volve field Daily Drilling Report DDR-TEST-00130 — wellbore not published in this release
source_system: Equinor Volve / public DDR release — Volve field Daily Drilling
excerpt:
06:00 - 09:00: Skidded rig from f-11 to f-5
09:00 - 09:15: Handover meeting of well from production department to intervention.
09:15 - 09:45: Changed permanent hatch with WL hatch.
09:45 - 10:00: Rigged up chiksan manifold to KWV. Leak tested same to 20/345 bar for 5/10 min. Removed top cap on XMT.
10:00 - 10:10: Held toolbox talk before lifting riser section and BOP to XMT.
10:10 - 11:00: Lifted and installed riser section and BOP from moonpool area to XMT.
11:00 - 11:35: Connected altus pump and hoses for local control of DHSV and HMV.
11:35 - 12:20: Lifted lubricator and GIH from catwalk and hung off above riser section on drill floor.
12:20 - 12:30: Held toolbox meeting prior to installing BHA me plug) in lubricator.
12:30 - 15:20: M/u BHA for run me plug). Leak tested lubricator to 20/345 bar 5/10 min.
15:20 - 15:45: Equalized and opened HMV and DHSV. WHP 45 bar
15:45 - 16:20: Opened SV and RIH with BHA me plug) to 278 mmd. Schlumberger checked tools.
16:20 - 19:10: RIH and observed BHA starting to float. Reduced speed to 20 m/min and continue to RIH to 3630 mmd. Took PUW every 500 m. Depth PUW 500 1310 1000 1830 1500 2490 2000 3020 2500 3780 3000 4600 3500 5450 actual friction factor 0,3.
19:10 - 20:00: Performed correlation passes prior to installing plug. Observed some problems while correlating due to stick slip on BHA.
20:00 - 20:25: Positioned and installed plug with mid packer element at 3592 mmd. Lost 300 lbs on tension during installation. WHP before/after setting 45 45 bar.
20:25 - 22:25: POOH from 3592 m to surface WHP decreased from 45 bar to 2,4 bar while POOH.
22:25 - 22:45: Attempted to leak test XMT. Unable due to leakage. Most likely in PWV.
22:45 - 23:00: Pressured up tubing to 50 bar to inflow test SV and HMV.
23:00 - 23:25: Closed and inflow tested HMV and SV.
23:25 - 00:00: Bled down tubing pressure to 5 bar. Inflow tested me plug to 45 bar DP for 30 min. Pressure increased 0,15 bar 30 min
